prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a production-oriented garment mockup BASE for an interactive t-shirt customizer: ONE SINGLE plain white classic regular-fit short-sleeved cotton crew-neck t-shirt, FRONT VIEW, isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Square canvas. Photorealistic studio apparel photography of a 180 gsm combed cotton shirt on an invisible mannequin, relaxed but almost planar printable chest. Orthographic camera exactly straight-on, zero rotation, zero perspective tilt, centered vertically and horizontally, symmetrical left and right. Entire garment including collar, both sleeves and full bottom hem visible. Garment bounding box approximately x=10% to 90%, y=12% to 88%, clear transparent margins on every side. Normal classic fit, not oversize; short sleeves angled gently down; clean straight hem. Real cotton weave visible at close view, fine double-needle seams and realistically ribbed collar. White cotton should stay neutral clean off-white with restrained delicate shading, not beige. Broad soft even frontal studio lighting, readable outline. Extremely mild folds confined near outer side seams and sleeve edges; central chest and belly smooth and clear for adding custom print later. No print, no text, no logos, no label, no watermark, no person, no skin, no arms, no head, no hanger, no mannequin parts, no background objects, no shadow on a ground plane, no floor, no checkerboard painted in the image. Exactly one garment, not a comparison sheet, not a pair. Transparent background, photographic fabric rather than vector drawing or flat silhouette.
